tools.name: get_system_info
tools.description: Get CPU name/load, RAM usage, disk space per drive, hostname, username, OS version, and uptime.

tools.name: get_processes
tools.description: List running processes with PID, name, CPU seconds, and memory (MB). Sort by memory, cpu, or name.

tools.name: process_resource_hotspots
tools.description: Return top CPU and memory process hotspots for quick triage.

tools.name: wait_for_process_state
tools.description: Wait until a process becomes running or stopped by PID or process name.

tools.name: process_tree
tools.description: Build a process tree snapshot rooted by PID or processName.

tools.name: process_network_map
tools.description: Map active TCP connections to owning processes with aggregate counts.

tools.name: list_windows_detailed
tools.description: List all visible top-level windows with full metadata: title, PID, class, position, size, and state (normal/minimized/maximized).

tools.name: move_resize_window
tools.description: Move and/or resize a window by pid, hwnd, or title. Omit any of x/y/width/height to keep that dimension unchanged.

pid.description: Target window process ID (preferred for reliability)

hwnd.description: Target window handle as decimal string

title.description: Substring of the window title to match

tools.name: minimize_maximize_window
tools.description: Minimize, maximize, or restore a window by pid, hwnd, or title.

pid.description: Target window process ID (preferred for reliability)

hwnd.description: Target window handle as decimal string

title.description: Substring of the window title to match

tools.name: get_focused_app_state
tools.description: Return full context for the currently focused window: title, PID, process name, executable path, position, size, and window state.

tools.name: window_hierarchy
tools.description: Enumerate all visible top-level windows with their hwnd, title, Win32 class name, and PID (up to 80 entries).

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Kill a process by PID or by name.

tools.name: get_open_ports
tools.description: List all TCP ports currently in LISTEN state with the owning process name.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find files by glob pattern under a path. Returns full path, size, and last-modified date.

tools.name: read_file_lines
tools.description: Read a specific line range from a file. Ideal for large files where you only need a portion.

endLine.description: 1-based end line inclusive (default: startLine + 199, max 500 lines returned)

tools.name: grep_file
tools.description: Search a file for lines matching a regex pattern. Returns matching lines with their line numbers.

maxMatches.description: Max matching lines to return (default 100, max 500)

tools.name: diff_files
tools.description: Compare two files line-by-line and return a structured diff with added/removed hunks.

tools.name: hash_file
tools.description: Compute a cryptographic hash (MD5, SHA1, SHA256, or SHA512) of a file.

tools.name: watch_file_changes
tools.description: Stat a file and return its current size and modification time. Useful for polling a file for changes between calls.

tools.name: get_screen_size
tools.description: Get the pixel dimensions of all connected monitors.

tools.name: check_service_status
tools.description: Query the status of a Windows service by name. Returns status, displayName, and startType.

tools.name: get_installed_software
tools.description: List installed programs from the Windows registry uninstall keys.

tools.name: get_startup_items
tools.description: List programs configured to run at Windows startup from registry Run keys.

tools.name: get_event_log_entries
tools.description: Read recent Windows Event Log entries from Application or System log.

level.description: Filter by level: Error, Warning, Information

tools.name: workflow_runbook_execute
tools.description: Execute a multi-step MCP runbook with retries, per-step timeout, and stop/continue policies.

steps.description: Ordered list of tool steps to execute

arguments.description: Arguments to pass into the tool

timeoutMs.description: Per-step timeout in ms (default 0 = no local timeout)

continueOnError.description: Continue runbook if this step fails (default false)

note.description: Optional operator note for this step

stopOnFail.description: Stop workflow on first failed step unless step has continueOnError=true (default true)

maxSteps.description: Maximum allowed steps for this workflow run (default 50, max 100)

maxTotalMs.description: Maximum total workflow duration in ms (default 120000, max 600000)

tools.name: read_clipboard
tools.description: Read the current Windows clipboard contents as text.

tools.name: write_clipboard
tools.description: Set the Windows clipboard to the given text.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a Windows system-tray balloon notification.

tools.name: get_execution_profile
tools.description: Get current execution profile. quiet = no pre-action announcements, visible = announce before risky actions.

tools.name: set_execution_profile
tools.description: Set execution profile for interactive tools. Use mode="visible" and announceActions=true to show upcoming actions before click/type/etc.

announceActions.description: Whether to announce actions via notifications in visible mode

preActionDelayMs.description: Delay before action in visible mode (0..5000, default 700)

tools.name: get_mouse_position
tools.description: Get the current mouse cursor position as {x, y} in screen pixels.

tools.name: move_mouse
tools.description: Move the mouse cursor to absolute screen coordinates.

x.description: X in pixels from left edge

y.description: Y in pixels from top edge

tools.name: click_mouse
tools.description: Click (or double-click) at a screen coordinate. Moves cursor first.

tools.name: drag_mouse
tools.description: Click-and-drag from one screen coordinate to another (left mouse button).

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the mouse wheel at the current cursor position.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type literal text into the focused window. Special characters are auto-escaped. Use focus_window first if needed.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Send a key combination using SendKeys syntax. Examples: "^c" (Ctrl+C), "^v" (Ctrl+V), "%{F4}" (Alt+F4), "{ENTER}", "{TAB}", "+{TAB}" (Shift+Tab), "^z" (Undo), "^a" (Select All), "{ESC}", "{F5}".

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the screen (or a specific monitor) as a PNG image.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List all visible windows with their titles, PIDs, and process names.

tools.name: focus_window
tools.description: Bring a window to the foreground by pid, hwnd, or title (partial, case-insensitive).

pid.description: Target window process ID (preferred for reliability)

hwnd.description: Target window handle as decimal string

tools.name: get_active_window
tools.description: Get the title, PID, and process name of the currently focused window.

tools.name: close_window
tools.description: Send a graceful close (WM_CLOSE) to a window matched by pid, hwnd, or title. The app may prompt to save.

pid.description: Target window process ID (preferred for reliability)

hwnd.description: Target window handle as decimal string

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command or script string. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a local file. Returns text content and metadata.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write text content to a local file. Creates parent directories if needed.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to write

append.description: If true, append to existing file instead of overwriting

tools.name: get_environment_vars
tools.description: List environment variables visible to the os-bridge process. Optionally filter by prefix.

prefix.description: Only return variables whose name starts with this prefix (case-insensitive)

names.description: Exact variable names to return. If provided, prefix is ignored.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open a URL in the default Windows browser using Start-Process.

url.description: URL to open (must begin with http:// or https://)

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and sub-directories at a given path. Returns names, types, sizes, and mod times.

filter.description: Optional glob-style extension filter, e.g. ".js" or ".json"

tools.name: get_window_rect
tools.description: Get the screen coordinates and dimensions of a window by pid, hwnd, or title. Returns {x, y, width, height, pid, processName, title, matchedBy}.

pid.description: Target window process ID (preferred for reliability)

hwnd.description: Target window handle as decimal string

tools.name: screenshot_window
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a specific window by pid, hwnd, or title. Focuses and crops to the window bounds. Falls back to full screen if no target is found.

pid.description: Target window process ID (preferred for reliability)

hwnd.description: Target window handle as decimal string

tools.name: shell_open
tools.description: Open a persistent interactive shell session (PowerShell or cmd). Returns a sessionId for subsequent shell_send / shell_read / shell_close calls.

cwd.description: Working directory for the session (default: server cwd)

tools.name: shell_send
tools.description: Send a command to an open shell session and wait for output to settle. Returns stdout + stderr captured since last send.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to wait for output to settle (default 5000)

tools.name: shell_read
tools.description: Read buffered stdout/stderr from an open session without sending a command.

clear.description: If true, clear the buffer after reading (default false)

tools.name: shell_close
tools.description: Close and destroy a persistent shell session.

tools.name: shell_list_sessions
tools.description: List all currently open persistent shell sessions.

tools.name: get_control_state
tools.description: Check the current AI input control state: whether emergency stop or user pause is active.

tools.name: request_control
tools.description: AI announces it is about to use input tools. Returns whether control is granted. Advisory — input tools work regardless, but calling this is good practice.

tools.name: release_control
tools.description: AI announces it has finished using input tools.

tools.name: pause_control
tools.description: USER calls this to pause AI input tools (mouse/keyboard). AI input is blocked until resume_control.

tools.name: resume_control
tools.description: Resume AI input tools after a user pause.

tools.name: emergency_stop
tools.description: HARD STOP — immediately disables all AI mouse/keyboard/window tools. Requires reset_emergency_stop to re-enable. Use when you need to take over urgently.

tools.name: reset_emergency_stop
tools.description: Clear the emergency stop flag and re-enable AI input tools.

tools.name: get_disk_usage
tools.description: Get disk space usage per drive (total, used, free in GB) plus overall summary.

drive.description: Optional specific drive letter (e.g. "C"). Default: all drives.

tools.name: ping_host
tools.description: Ping a hostname or IP address and return latency, packet loss, and reachability.

host.description: Hostname or IP address to ping

tools.name: get_network_adapters
tools.description: List network adapters with name, status, MAC address, and IP addresses.

tools.name: manage_service
tools.description: Start, stop, or restart a Windows service.

tools.name: get_battery_status
tools.description: Get battery charge level, status (charging/discharging/AC), and estimated time remaining.

tools.name: get_wifi_networks
tools.description: List available Wi-Fi networks with SSID, signal strength, and security type.

tools.name: find_in_files
tools.description: Recursively search files under a directory for lines matching a text or regex pattern.

pattern.description: Text or regex pattern to search for

tools.name: get_display_info
tools.description: Get display adapter info including name, resolution, refresh rate, and VRAM.

tools.name: process_snapshot
tools.description: Take a point-in-time snapshot of all running processes with CPU, memory, PID, and status.

tools.name: get_user_sessions
tools.description: List currently logged-in Windows user sessions.

tools.name: get_temp_files
tools.description: List temporary files in %TEMP% and Windows Temp, optionally filtered by age or extension.

olderThanDays.description: Only show files older than N days (default: 0 = all)

tools.name: get_firewall_rules
tools.description: List Windows Firewall rules (name, direction, action, protocol, port).

tools.name: get_hotkeys
tools.description: List global hotkeys registered on the system (via registry and common shortcuts).

tools.name: get_recent_files
tools.description: List recently opened files from the Windows Recent folder.

tools.name: system_health_check
tools.description: Run a comprehensive system health check: CPU, RAM, disk, services, and event log errors.

tools.name: get_scheduled_tasks
tools.description: List Windows scheduled tasks with name, status, next run time, and last result.

tools.name: get_usb_devices
tools.description: List connected USB devices with name, device ID, and status.

tools.name: cpu_benchmark
tools.description: Run a brief CPU benchmark (integer ops) and return estimated MOPS and relative score.

tools.name: memory_pressure_report
tools.description: Report on current memory pressure: total, used, free, paging activity, and high-memory processes.

tools.name: get_windows_version
tools.description: Get detailed Windows OS version info including build number, edition, and release ID.

tools.name: check_port_open
tools.description: Check if a TCP port on a host is open and responding.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List shared folders on this Windows machine.

tools.name: file_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a file: size, dates, hash, permissions, line count.

tools.name: directory_size
tools.description: Calculate total size of a directory recursively.

tools.name: window_screenshot_grid
tools.description: Take screenshots of multiple windows and return their titles and image metadata.

titles.description: Array of window title patterns to screenshot

tools.name: bulk_kill_processes
tools.description: Kill multiple processes by name pattern.

namePattern.description: Process name pattern to match (partial, case-insensitive)

dryRun.description: If true, only list matching processes without killing (default: true for safety)

tools.name: get_dns_info
tools.description: Resolve a hostname using DNS and return all IP addresses.

tools.name: tail_file
tools.description: Read the last N lines of a file (like Unix tail).

lines.description: Number of lines from end (default 50, max 500)

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file to a new location.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file. Cannot delete directories. Use with caution.

filePath.description: Absolute path to file to delete

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete (safety check)

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory (including all parent directories).

tools.name: archive_extract
tools.description: Extract a ZIP archive to a destination folder.

zipPath.description: Absolute path to the ZIP file

tools.name: whoami_info
tools.description: Get current user, domain, computer name, and privilege level.

tools.name: get_clipboard_history
tools.description: Attempt to read recent clipboard history entries (requires Windows Clipboard History to be enabled).

tools.name: get_uptime_detailed
tools.description: Get detailed system uptime: boot time, uptime in human-readable format, and current time.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List installed Windows fonts.

tools.name: get_power_plan
tools.description: Get the current active Windows power plan and list available plans.

tools.name: os_bridge_meta
tools.description: Get os-bridge metadata: version, tool count, capabilities summary, and platform info.
